calm.title: Doing well, with one little thing

reasonAllGood: Clean, roomy and checked. Keep it up: a few minutes a week is enough.
reasonNeverCleaned: We haven't cleaned together yet. Let's start with the files nobody needs.
reasonCleanLongAgo: It's been {{days}} days since we cleaned. Caches and temp files pile up.
reasonCleanAWhile: The last clean-up was {{days}} days ago. A quick once-over and done.
reasonDiskFull: Your {{drive}} drive is {{percent}}% full. With so little room everything slows down.
reasonDiskFilling: Your {{drive}} drive is at {{percent}}%. A good time to make room.
reasonThreats: I found {{count}} unresolved threat(s). Let's review them.
reasonNeverScanned: We haven't checked for malware yet. It takes a few minutes.
reasonScanLongAgo: The last malware check was {{days}} days ago.

party.title: Your PC can breathe!
party.body: Less junk, more room and a lighter PC. Thanks for looking after it.

settings.intro: Keeps you company and tells you how your PC feels. The same Tokkip as on your phone and in Tokkip PC.
settings.soundsDesc: A pop to start, a check when done and the party after a clean-up
settings.islandDesc: If you have Tokkip PC, its island tells you when you cleaned and when your PC needs a breather.
